reasons.plausibility: The hypothesis is scientifically problematic because Cu has negligible solid solubility in W and would likely form a separate, low-melting phase, severely degrading structural integrity and radiation resistance, contradicting the proposed mechanism of a stable lattice with controlled misfit.
reasons.testability: The proposed test is clear and feasible, with a well-defined falsification criterion based on comparing thermal conductivity and mechanical properties of Cu-modified vs. baseline alloys under simulated reactor conditions.
reasons.usefulness: The hypothesis is not useful because it is based on a fundamental metallurgical incompatibility (W-Cu immiscibility), making it a dead-end for researchers working on W-based HEAs for plasma-facing components.
